title: Tankers At A Crossroads
summary: Can growing ton-mile demand turn the market? The freight markets for 2018 have so far been disappointing for crude oil tankers. For the VLCC market, the supply-demand balance and the resulting freight rates are predominantly driven by OPEC production and exports.
